Class NSVGShape

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<NSVGShape>
org.lwjgl.nanovg.NSVGShape
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pointer
@NativeType("struct NSVGshape") public class NSVGShape extends Struct<NSVGShape>
struct NSVGshape {
    char id[64];
    NSVGpaint fill;
    NSVGpaint stroke;
    float opacity;
    float strokeWidth;
    float strokeDashOffset;
    float strokeDashArray[8];
    char strokeDashCount;
    char strokeLineJoin;
    char strokeLineCap;
    float miterLimit;
    char fillRule;
    unsigned char paintOrder;
    unsigned char flags;
    float bounds[4];
    char fillGradient[64];
    char strokeGradient[64];
    float xform[6];
    NSVGpath * paths;
    NSVGshape * next;
}

      public NSVGShape(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a NSVGShape instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
